title: polygala stephaniana
intro: Polygala stephaniana, commonly known as Yutan'gan in traditional Chinese medicine, is a plant species in the Polygalaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include its potential to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Polygala stephaniana are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal effects.
